name: jev-router
description: Suggests a Claude model and effort level for the message you are about to send, scored by the Jev decision model.

jevEndpoint.title: Jev endpoint
jevEndpoint.description: Full URL of a Jev-shaped decisions API. Merge Gateway by default; TypeSafe direct is https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, local Kev is http://127.0.0.1:8009/v1/systemone.

jevModel.title: Jev model
jevModel.description: Model id at that endpoint. Pinned, since the bars are tuned per version.

keyFile.title: Key file
keyFile.description: A .env file holding JEV_API_KEY or MERGE_GATEWAY_KEY, read when neither is in the environment.
